name: Distorted Distance

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Create a 60-foot-radius Sphere. For each visible creature inside, choose a speed boost of 20 feet until its next turn ends, or an Intelligence save against 2d10 Psychic and Difficult Terrain within the Sphere until its turn ends. Repeat this choice on entry or end of turn, at most once per turn per creature.
